operating_notes.text: 3.35 crore outstanding warrants lapsed along with amounts paid due to non-conversion within the 18-month period.
Of the ₹3,014.40 Cr warrant issue, ₹978.60 Cr was received and fully utilised by Q4FY26; the outstanding warrants lapsed on 24.04.2026 and 29.04.2026.
Q4FY26 regulatory income of ₹2,916.98 Cr was the main driver of PBT of ₹1,155.35 Cr.
Auditors disclaimed opinion on consolidated results due to inability to determine recovery of ₹4,705.74 Cr economic rights.

Office of the Commissioner Customs (Appeals) confirmed a lien on the company's bank accounts for ₹77.86 Cr over alleged FEMA violations, confirming a provisional order dated 09.12.2025; the company will appeal.
Reliance Infrastructure submitted a representation to SEBI, NSE, and BSE seeking review of the ASM framework and once-a-week trading restrictions.
Company undertook steps to enter AI technologies through subsidiaries including Reliance AI World, Reliance AI Apex, and Reliance AI One.

timeline.summary: On April 21, 2026, Reliance Infrastructure reported receipt of an order confirming provisional attachment of assets worth ₹670.48 Cr.
On April 24, 2026, Reliance Infrastructure announced the lapse of 3.35 crore outstanding warrants due to non-conversion.

On May 15, 2026, Reliance Infrastructure filed the monitoring agency report for Q4FY26 showing ₹978.60 Cr of the ₹3,014.40 Cr warrant issue received and fully utilised, with the outstanding warrants having lapsed in April 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,001.28 Cr (-2.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹918.07 Cr (-79.1% YoY).

On June 6, 2026, Reliance Infrastructure reported orders from the Office of the Commissioner Customs (Appeals) confirming a lien on its bank accounts for ₹77.86 Cr over alleged FEMA violations, confirming a December 9, 2025 provisional order; the company will appeal.
On June 7, 2026, Reliance Infrastructure submitted a formal representation to SEBI, NSE, and BSE seeking a review of the IBC-linked ASM framework and once-a-week trading restrictions.
Reliance Infrastructure incorporated AI-focused subsidiary entities to enter artificial intelligence technologies.
